extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.56[CR]- Recognize the verified North American, European and Far East Prime Video hosts consistently across sign-in, catalog navigation, cookies and region discovery.[CR]- Follow Amazon's verified regional relay addresses while keeping credential forms restricted to sign-in hosts and retail catalog handoffs restricted to the existing SSO route.[CR]- Normalize regional website identities for account discovery without inventing regional token or media API names.[CR]- Keep catalog and TV episode responses restricted to actual Prime Video sites after redirects; include the complete regional policy inventory and redirect decisions in diagnostics.
